extraction.Name: William Scissons, Jr.
extraction.Buyer: Mortgaged to J. P. Treweiler for $3000.00; records show mortgage of $6000.00 (additional $3000 on a garage purchase); records also show a deed on the land to Mr. Treweiler
extraction.NOTES: Mortgagee in possession since 1923. Allottee states mortgage on land was only $3000 and the other $3000 is on a garage he bought. Does not remember signing a deed to Treweiler; has a summons to answer a complaint by Treweiler praying for quieting of title, to be answered within 30 days from June 8th. Allottee states Treweiler has not given credit for all payments made and has charged excess prices for repairs. Allottee received patent in 1920 from the Farmer at Ponca. Did not make application for patent. Wife and her sister depend on him for support. Notary: S. W. Cross, commission expires 4-28-32.
